# `silk/platform/wasi/canonical`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

The canonical ABI allocator of every `wasm32-wasip2` component.

## When to use
The standard library's catalog names this module as a `wasm32-wasip2` support module, so every
component exports `cabi_realloc`, whatever its runtime. Applications do not call it.

## Details
The canonical ABI and the command adapter allocate through `cabi_realloc`, so their storage stays
in the program's heap; a separate `memory.grow` allocator would overlap it.
